title: Travel With Me
style: indie folk pop, 92 BPM, wanderlust theme, invitation energy, male vocal warm and open NZ/AU accent, acoustic guitar lead, open landscapes, cross-cultural freedom, adventure without sentimentality, original sound, V4_5ALL
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
Pack the bag before the morning
Leave before the town is warning
Travel light — take the road that bends
Travel with me — where it ends

[CHORUS]
Travel with me — don't ask why
Travel with me — watch it fly
Travel with me — NZ to WA
Travel with me — any way
Travel with me — Dunedin cold
Travel with me — Perth heat bold
Travel with me — that's the call
Travel with me — through it all

[VERSE 2]
Nicaragua now — Pacific sun
Michelle came — everyone
Ruby, Wesley — family runs
Travel with me — we're not done

[BRIDGE]
The cook doesn't give you the recipe.
The navigator doesn't tell you the route.
Travel with me — you find it when you arrive.

[OUTRO]
Travel with me. Still going.
